name: parcel-transport-management
description: Reproducible quality tooling for the Parcel Transport Management Odoo addon

scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.lint: npm run lint:python && npm run lint:javascript
scripts.format:check: npm run format:python:check && npm run format:web:check
scripts.format: uv run ruff format addons && prettier --write . --ignore-unknown
scripts.fix: uv run ruff check --fix addons && npm run format
